entries.title: About jspassgen | Security Architecture and Principles
entries.content: Skip to main content jspassgen v0.0.19 GitHub 🌓 About jspassgen jspassgen was created to solve a persistent vulnerability in modern authentication workflows: the reliance on proprietary, cloud-hosted, and telemetry-heavy password generators. Design Principles Zero External Dependencies: The core generator library contains zero third-party packages, preventing software supply chain compromises. Local Trust Boundary: Passwords never touch a network socket. All entropy is derived from hardware noise via operating system CSPRNG interfaces. NIST SP 800-63B Compliance: Full adherence to modern digital identity guidelines, discouraging arbitrary composition rules in favour of length and entropy. Post-Quantum Preparedness: Hardened key derivation primitives designed to resist future quantum acceleration. Author & Maintainer Created and maintained by Sebastien Rousseau. Dual licensed under Apache-2.0 and MIT.

Generate mathematically verifiable, high-entropy passwords, EFF Diceware passphrases, and Juels-Rivest honeypot decoy credentials. Entirely client-side in pure WebCrypto. Exclude Ambiguous Characters (0, O, 1, l, I, |) Active Honeywords Decoy Set (Juels-Rivest Scheme) Store all credentials in your database. If any decoy is attempted during authentication, an immediate security alarm triggers before the genuine master key is breached. Comprehensive Market EvaluationHow jspassgen Outclasses Industry Competitors We evaluated every major password generator on the web across 14 cryptographic, architectural, and privacy dimensions. The verdict: jspassgen is the only modern generator engineered from first principles with zero cloud reliance, verifiable Shannon entropy, and post-quantum resistance. was engineered because legacy password generators still enforce obsolete 1990s composition rules instead of measuring true entropy. ⚛Post-Quantum Resistance Leveraging memory-hard KDF derivation based on Argon2id principles to protect secrets against Grover quantum search algorithms and massively parallel ASIC cracking arrays. 🎲EFF Diceware Wordlists Generates memorable multi-word passphrases using the Electronic Frontier Foundation (EFF) curated dictionary of 7,776 words, yielding 12.92 bits of cryptographic entropy per word. 🍯Juels-Rivest Honeywords Active breach detection mechanism that generates authentic-looking decoy passwords alongside the master key. If a decoy is entered, an alert triggers before the master key is compromised. 📐True Shannon Entropy Calculates information-theoretic Shannon entropy $H(X) = -\sum p(x) \log_2 p(x)$ across the symbol distribution, rather than simply multiplying character count by a constant. ⚡Zero Dependencies Pure standard library implementation. The core engine has zero third-party dependencies, eliminating supply-chain vulnerabilities, bloated lockfiles, and telemetry leaks. 🛡Local-First Trust Boundary Every cryptographic operation executes inside your local browser or terminal process. No passwords, seeds, or telemetry bytes ever traverse the network. One command. Any terminal. Run jspassgen directly via npx without installation, or install it globally to script secure password generation in CI/CD pipelines, DevOps workflows, and terminal environments. View on npm (0.0.19) Read CLI Documentation bash - jspassgen# Instant generation with npx $ npx jspassgen -l 32 --symbols ✓ Generated high-entropy password: k9#vM8$wP2!zQ5@xR7^yN1*tL4&jF6%h Entropy: 190.4 bits | Pool: 94 | TTL: 45s # EFF Diceware passphrase $ npx jspassgen --diceware -w 5 --separator "-" ✓ Generated passphrase: correct-horse-battery-staple-quantum42Technical ClarificationsFrequently Asked Questions Everything you need to know about the cryptography, offline privacy, and security model of jspassgen.
